race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
race.verdict: TAN RAPIDO won at this course in July and has returned from a break with solid efforts at Wolverhampton, including when shaping better than the bare result latest. Hucklesbrook looks well handicapped now, while Kiniro returns to this C&D, where he's twice a winner, and is worth another chance after his stalls mishap last time. TAN RAPIDO HUCKLESBROOK KINIRO
race.bettingForecast: Tan Rapido (5/1), Brosay (11/2), Supreme King (13/2), Hucklesbrook (7/1), Baldomero (7/1), Uncle Don (8/1), Angel Gabriel (8/1), Kiniro (10/1), Artagnan (12/1), Shaman Champion (14/1), Seven Questions (20/1), Star Chorus (20/1)
